events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type:** 美国国务院外交电报,从美国驻莫尔兹比港大使馆发往檀香山USCINCPAC,日期为1985年1月28日(电报编号85 PORT MORESBY 199, DTG 280002Z JAN 85)。

**Parties Involved:** 美国驻莫尔兹比港大使馆;巴布亚新几内亚国家情报组织(NIO);USCINCPAC;第43太空联队;国务卿;多名巴布亚新几内亚政府官员,包括省长和总理。

**Incident Summary:** 1985年1月24日晚,巴布亚新几内亚上空报告出现多架高空高速飞行器。在当地居民报告目击不明空中现象并引发严重公众恐慌后,巴布亚新几内亚国家情报组织向美国大使馆进行了非正式询问。一名新几内亚航空(Air Niugini)飞行员报告称,雷达探测到飞行器以高空高速从南向北飞行。这些目击事件令当地居民极度恐慌,以至于省长召开公众会议以回应关切,总理在周末访问其选区期间出席了会议。

**Key Details:** 韦瓦克(Wewak)的NIO官员报告了可信的目击者陈述,包括快速移动的发光物体、尾迹和相关噪音。美国大使馆将这些信息描述为"非常粗略",并要求USCINCPAC立即澄清1985年1月24日是否有美国军用飞机在巴布亚新几内亚领空执行任务。

**Document Provenance:** 由美国国务院代理主任约翰·鲍尔斯(John Powers)于2026年2月25日完整公开。文件标签:MARR, PP。密级:常规/非机密。

events.title: Tajik Air Pilots Report UFO at 41,000 Feet Over Kazakhstan
events.record_description:
This document is a U.S. Department of State diplomatic cable from the U.S. Embassy in Dushanbe, Tajikistan to the Secretary of State in Washington, D.C. on January 31, 1994.
On January 27, 1994 one Tajik pilot and three American citizens encountered an UAP flying a 747 jet at 41,000 feet over Kazakhstan.  Object was a bright light of enormous intensity and approached over the horizon to the east at great speed and a much higher altitude.  Several pictures were taken of the craft making 90 degree turns, doing corkscrews and maneuvering in circles a great rates of speed.  Object was reported as resembling a bullet in flight.  Visual estimation of the contrails were at 100,000 feet, which was too high to leave contrails by ordinary aircraft.
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** U.S. Department of State diplomatic cable (MRN 94 DUSHANBE 259) from the U.S. Embassy in Dushanbe, Tajikistan to SECSTATE Washington, D.C., dated January 31, 1994.

**Parties Involved:** Tajik Air Chief Pilot Amcit ED Rhodes and two American pilot colleagues flying a Boeing 747 at 41,000 feet over Kazakhstan.

**Sighting Summary:** On January 27, 1994, the flight crew encountered an unidentified flying object described as a bright light of enormous intensity approaching from the east at great speed and much higher altitude than their aircraft. The object reportedly performed extraordinary maneuvers including 90-degree turns, corkscrews, and circular movements at high rates of speed. Visual estimation placed the object and its contrails at approximately 100,000 feet—far too high for ordinary aircraft to leave contrails. The object was described as resembling a bullet in flight.

**Key Details:** The crew took several photographs of the object during the encounter. The cable was classified ROUTINE and distributed to multiple U.S. embassies in the region including Moscow, Tashkent, Ashgabat, Almaty, Beijing, and Bishkek, as well as CIA Washington.

**Document Provenance:** Released in full by John Powers, Acting-Director, U.S. Department of State on February 25, 2026. Document reference CSP-2025-00640, declassified per E.O. 12356.

events.report_summary_zh:

**Parties Involved:** 塔吉克航空首席飞行员美国公民ED Rhodes及两名美国飞行员同事,驾驶波音747飞机在哈萨克斯坦上空41,000英尺高度飞行。

**Sighting Summary:** 1994年1月27日,机组人员遭遇一不明飞行物,被描述为一道极其强烈的明亮光线,从东方以极快速度接近,飞行高度远高于他们的飞机。据报告,该物体做出了非同寻常的机动动作,包括90度转向、螺旋飞行以及高速圆周运动。目视估计该物体及其尾迹位于约100,000英尺高度——这一高度远超普通飞机能够留下尾迹的极限。该物体被描述为形似飞行中的子弹。

**Key Details:** 机组人员在遭遇过程中拍摄了该物体的多张照片。该电报密级为ROUTINE(常规),分发至该地区多个美国大使馆,包括莫斯科、塔什干、阿什哈巴德、阿拉木图、北京和比什凯克,以及CIA华盛顿总部。

events.title: Mexico Weekly Political Blotter, Sep 11-15, 2023
events.record_description: On September 12, 20023 the Mexican Congress heard testimony on UAP from experts related to the debate about an Aerial Space Protection Law, which, if approved, would make Mexico the first country to formally acknowledge the presence of alien life on earth. Experts asked legislators to recognize UAP, guarantee airspace security, and allow UAP to be studied.  They presented to alleged alien corpses and videos of Mexican pilot’s encounters with fast-moving flying objects during flight. Disagreement about the efficacy and validity of the purported alien corpses.
events.title_ocr_original: State Department UAP Cable 5, Mexico, September 16, 2003
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** U.S. Embassy Mexico Weekly Political Blotter, classified UNCLASSIFIED, transmitted via routine cable (MRN 23 MEXICO 2544) from AMEMBASSY MEXICO to WASHDC, SECSTATE.

**Parties Involved:** U.S. Department of State, Embassy Mexico; Mexican Congress; alien life testimony experts.

**Event Summary:** This edition of Mission Mexico's Political Blotter (covering September 11-15, 2023) includes a section titled "Mexican Congress Hears Testimony on Alien Life." The cable references this alongside domestic political developments including MORENA party challenges, INE commission appointments, Mexico City security secretary changes, criminal prosecutions in Guerrero, and gubernatorial campaigns.

**Key Details:** The cable provides no specific details about the Congressional testimony content, witness identities, or alleged evidence presented. events.title: P-8A Observes Unidentified Low-Flying Object 55 NM Northwest of Latakia, Syria
events.record_description:
This document is a mission briefing summarizing an observation of Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) by a U.S. military platform near Latakia, Syria.
A U.S. military pilot flying a P-8A aircraft reported observing an object via the aircraft’s EO/IR sensor, which they characterized as appearing to be in “sea skim mode,” traveling at approximately 500 knots (575 mph) on a southeasterly heading. The P-8A lost visual contact with the object after two minutes.
All descriptive and estimative language contained in this report reflects the reporter’s subjective interpretation at the time of the event. Such characterizations should not be interpreted as a conclusive indication of the presence or absence of any intrinsic object features or performance characteristics.
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Mission Report, declassified by USCENTCOM Chief of Staff on 20 May 2025.

**Incident Overview:** While monitoring KCTG activity in the Eastern Mediterranean, a U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon aircraft observed an unidentified low-flying object approximately 55 nautical miles northwest of Latakia, Syria. The object was detected traveling at approximately 500 knots on a southeasterly heading outbound from KCTG.

**Timeline:** At 1310Z on 18 November 2016, the P-8A detected what appeared to be a possible missile launch via the EO/IR sensor from an unknown origin. The object appeared to be in sea skim mode, traveling at approximately 500 knots. P-8A position was 26 nautical miles south of the object at detection (1312Z). At approximately 1312Z, the P-8A lost visual contact with the object roughly 40 NM northwest of Latakia. The object was observed to pass between Russian INGUL ARS vessel, a U/I vessel, and a U/I object.

**Weather & Assessment:** P-8 aircrew characterized visibility as clear with no range limitations. The mission commander characterized the interaction as safe. This was the first observed occurrence of possible missile activity by P-8 aircraft in the Eastern Mediterranean, assessed to be standard activity consistent with KCTG operations. Video footage referenced as available at provided link.

**Approved for Release:** AARO, document reference USCENTCOM MDR 26-0038 to MDR 26-0046.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type:** 任务报告，由美国中央司令部(USCENTCOM)参谋长于2025年5月20日解密。

**事件概述:** 在监视东地中海KCTG活动期间，一架美国海军P-8A"波塞冬"巡逻机在叙利亚拉塔基亚(Latakia)西北约55海里处观察到一个身份不明的低空飞行物体。该物体被探测到以大约500节的速度向东南方向飞行，来自KCTG的出境方向。

**时间线:** 2016年11月18日1310Z时，P-8A通过EO/IR传感器探测到疑似来自未知源头的导弹发射。该物体似乎处于掠海模式，以大约500节的速度飞行。探测时(1312Z)P-8A的位置在该物体以南26海里处。大约在1312Z时，P-8A在拉塔基亚西北约40海里处失去了与该物体的视觉接触。观察到该物体在俄罗斯INGUL号ARS舰艇、一艘身份不明船只和一个身份不明物体之间通过。

**天气与评估:** P-8机组人员描述能见度清晰，无距离限制。任务指挥官将此次互动定性为安全。这是P-8飞机在东地中海首次观察到的可能的导弹活动，评估为符合KCTG行动的标准活动。视频录像可通过提供的链接获取。

**批准发布:** AARO，文件编号USCENTCOM MDR 26-0038至MDR 26-0046。

events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Range Fouler Debrief Form, a standardized U.S. Navy reporting form for unauthorized intrusions into controlled airspace during military operations. Declassified by MG Richard A. Harrison.

**Mission Details:** ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance) mission conducted on May 14, 2020, at 20:40:00 (night). Mission altitude: 20,000 feet. Contact occurred at latitude 28314, longitude 49524 (Arabian Gulf region). Wind direction at contact altitude was constant.

**Encounter Description:** While performing an ISR tasking (ULTN/Black Hot/Lin), a solid white object flew through the field of view. The crew temporarily lost visual contact but re-acquired the object shortly thereafter. The crew followed the object as it appeared to make erratic movements above the water. During the follow, the crew was able to obtain 4x zoom on the object but lost tracking due to poor track placement. The sensor operator continuously manipulated the sensor to maintain eyes on the object, with waves of the water in the background being visible while the object was not.

**Technical Data:** Radar equipped with AIM-9x capability. Stable trackfile was intermittent. ATFLIR Autotrack was not achieved. Number of contacts in group: 1. Contact was moving and round in shape. Display tapes were ripped for the entire interaction and saved as .wmv files.

**Provenance:** Approved for Release to AARO (All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office) on 01/26/26. Document reference: USCM-2022-NMDR 26-0019.

events.title: Range Fouler Debrief: 3x Unidentified Small Air Contacts, North Arabian Sea
events.record_description:
This document is a Range Fouler Debrief Form, a standardized reporting form the U.S. Navy uses to record the circumstances surrounding an unauthorized intrusion into controlled airspace during active military operations or training. These reports contain a narrative description of the observer’s experiences. 
A U.S. military operator reported an encounter with a group of three “unidentified small air contacts” over the North Arabian Sea. The reporter described the UAP as having “wings/airframe” structure, and as initially bearing on a westerly heading. The operator tracked one UAP before losing sight of it behind a cloud. Upon regaining contact, the operator reported observing two additional UAP to the east of the first. The report states that all three objects then “appeared to maintain their relative course, speed, and altitude.”
All descriptive and estimative language contained in this report reflects the reporter’s subjective interpretation at the time of the event. Such characterizations should not be interpreted as a conclusive indication of the presence or absence of any intrinsic object features or performance characteristics.
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Range Fouler Debrief Form, U.S. Navy standardized reporting form for unauthorized intrusions into controlled airspace during military operations.

**Observer:** O-3 rank pilot from squadron HSM-73, conducting routine night operations. Mission description: SSC (Side No. 705, Buno 168122). Contact working area designation 21440, contact latitude/longitude 14a, contact altitude approximately 22000 feet.

**Incident Summary:** On 24 August 2020 at 00:04:30 hours (night), the observer reported 3x possible unidentified small air contacts in the North Arabian Sea. The observer initially tracked 1x unknown air contact before losing sight as it went behind a cloud. When contact on the unknown air contact was regained, 2x additional unknown air contacts were seen due east of the initial contact location. All 3x unknown air contacts appeared to maintain their relative course, speed, and altitude.

**Contact Details:** Distance to contact was unknown. Speed of contact was unknown. Precise course of contact was unknown, but appeared to be on a westerly heading. No interaction took place between observer and the unknown air contacts. Wind direction at contact altitude: 310 degrees at 5 knots. Contact was moving at 270 degrees bearing, speed unknown. Observer checked "Round" contact shape and "Wings/Airframe" structure.

**Equipment:** Other radar equipped (not AIM-9x self-track, ATFLIR autotrack, or stable trackfile). Number of contacts in group: 3. EA indications: None checked (ECM, Letter, False Trackfiles, Other/Ambiguous).

**Provenance:** Declassified by MG Richard A. Harrison, USCENTCOM MDR 26-0038 to 26-0046. Approved for release to AARO 03/27/26.

events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Range Fouler Debrief Form (USCENTCOM MDR 26-0028), declassified by USCPUBLISHINGOFFICE on December 16, 2021, and approved for release to AARO under FOUO/PA protocols.

**Reporting Party:** U.S. military pilot, rank O-2, assigned to squadron 482 ATKG, crew position: Pilot. Detection occurred at dusk during an ISR mission at 18,000 feet altitude. Contact was assessed as moving at 150/230 knots.

**Sighting Summary:** The pilot observed an initial object flying through the screen and began tracking it. The initial object was then surpassed by a second object of the same size and shape but traveling at a much higher speed. At one point during the tracking sequence, three objects appeared on screen simultaneously, moving amongst each other. The contact was described as "other shape" with apparent propulsion, exhibiting characteristics not matching conventional aircraft profiles.

**Key Details:** MGRS grid of initial contact: 39RWL26. The objects were detected visually; radar type listed as "Other" with AIM-9x self-track capability. No stable trackfile was achieved. The pilot noted the objects were moving and confirmed wind direction at contact altitude was 150/230. The report emphasizes that no identifying information for aircrew or squadron is recorded for analysis per SPEAR sanitization protocols.

**Provenance:** Form completed August 31, 2020; approved for public release March 16, 2026 (document 000001).

A U.S. military operator reported tracking a “round, cold object” over the Gulf of Aden for eight minutes via “black hot” IR sensor, making the UAP appear “bright white.” The report states that the UAP was “traveling 168 degrees at 277 mph” and “made a few abrupt directional changes” during the encounter.

events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

Range Fouler Reporting Form from 172 ATKS (172nd Attack Squadron), a standardized U.S. Navy form used to record unauthorized intrusions into controlled airspace during military operations.

**Event Details**

On 4 September 2020 at 21:09 local time, military operators tracked an unidentified contact over the Gulf of Aden at location 23819 (MGRS position 38P LT 74). The contact was detected during night operations using IR (infrared) sensors traveling 168 degrees at 277 mph. The crew observed the object for 8 minutes (21:09z to 21:17z, 04SEP2020).

**Object Characteristics**

The IR sensor, set to "black hot" mode at -39 degrees below aircraft altitude, displayed the object as "bright white," indicating a round, cold object. The sensor's slant range was 6.17 nautical miles with a ground range of 8.81 kilometers. The object made "a few abrupt directional changes" during the 8-minute observation period. The contact was moving and maintained a round shape throughout the encounter.

**Aircraft & Equipment**

The observing crew was equipped with radar, stable trackfile capability, and ATFLIR (Advanced Targeting Forward Looking Infrared) autotrack systems. Mission designation CAS (Close Air Support), BFK, marked as ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance). Contact altitude was estimated at 62000 feet, with the object described as "altitude constant."

**Classification & Source**

Declassified by MG Richard A. Harrison, USCENTCOM 29-0028. Document approved for release to AARO - FOUO/PA applies. Form filed by O-3 rank aircrew member in "Other" crew position from 172 ATKS Squadron.

**物体特征**

IR传感器设置为"黑热"模式，位于低于飞机高度-39度位置，显示该物体为"亮白色"，表明是一个圆形、冷源物体。传感器的斜距为6.17海里，地面距离为8.81公里。在8分钟观察期间，该物体进行了"数次突然的方向变化"。该接触目标处于移动状态，在整个遭遇过程中保持圆形形状。

events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

Mission Report (MISREP undefined-7561279) documenting a Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena observation during an Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) mission over the Eastern Mediterranean and Syria-Iraq border region.

**Mission Timeline**

At 1355Z on 14a (29 May 2022), the reporting unit took off from Sigonella Airbase (LICZ), Italy. At 1424Z, control was handed over from the Launch and Recovery Element (LRE). From 1507Z to 0906Z, the unit collected signals intelligence (SIGINT) via airborne handler. At 1551Z, the asset was on station in the Special Reconnaissance Operations (SRO) track (41EMD). From 1938Z to 0230Z, the unit conducted an Immediate IMINT (imagery intelligence) mission supporting ISO 603 AOCOP HUMMER SICKLE IVO 41EMD over Eastern Mediterranean.

**UAP Encounter**

At 2147Z, the unit was reacted to by 1-3 Air Combat Fighter Tactics (ACFT), including one possible Russian Air Force SU-30. At 0011Z, the observer noted one probable SU-27/35 landing at Al Assad Airfield, Iraq. At 0117Z, one possible small UAP was observed. At 0230Z, the unit was cleared to return to base (RTB), going off station at 0616Z, and landing at LRCT at 1025Z after being handed back to the LRE at 0934Z.

**Document Provenance**

Declassified by MG Richard A. Harrison, USCENTCOM Chief of Staff, on 8 October 2025. Flight was exploited by DGS-IN and DGS4. Originally classified SECRET//NOFORN; downgraded under 3.5c FOIA Exemption (b)(6). MDR 25-0094 thru MDR 25-0099 / JS-250710-TMBS. Approved for release to AARO.

**UAP Encounter**

2147Z时，该单位遭遇1至3架空战战斗机战术单位（ACFT）的反应，其中包括一架可能的俄罗斯空军SU-30。0011Z时，观察员注意到一架疑似SU-27/35在伊拉克阿萨德空军基地降落。0117Z时，观测到一个可能的小型UAP。0230Z时，该单位获准返回基地（RTB），0616Z时离开任务区域，0934Z时控制权移交回LRE，1025Z时在LRCT降落。

**Document Type:** Declassified U.S. Military Mission Report (MISREP undefined-8353978), released by AARO under FOIA exemption 3.5c.

**Mission Details:** A 2-ship formation of F-15E aircraft (callsign CANX) conducted a DCA (Defensive Counter Air) IVO (In Vicinity Of) ESSA mission over Syria on February 21, 2023. The aircraft took off from Muwaffaq Salti Air Base (OJMS) in Jordan at 2220Z after receiving 37,000 lbs of fuel via air refueling.

**UAP Encounter:** At 0021Z-0024Z (1.4a time), the crew received MFT radar jamming IVO Shaddadi (1.4a location) at FL270. At 0025Z (1.4a), the crew observed "3X POSS UAP IVO SHADDADI" at FL240, with weapons system video (WSV) produced. A subsequent observation at 0135Z (1.4a) recorded "OBS 1X POSS BALLOON IVO SHADDADI" at FL210, also with WSV produced.

**Additional Operations:** The mission involved multiple air refuelings, with the aircraft receiving 33,500 lbs of fuel from GANDER track at 0134Z and 11,000 lbs from GANDER track at 0226Z. The aircraft landed at OJMS at 0435Z with ESD (emergency safe distance) procedures.

**Provenance:** Declassified by MG Richard A. Harrison, USCENTCOM Chief of Staff, on October 8, 2025. Document released through MDR 25-0094 thru MDR 25-0099 / JS-250710-TM8S.

**Mission Details:** 一个由2架F-15E战斗机组成的编队（呼号CANX）于2023年2月21日在叙利亚上空执行了ESSA地区附近的DCA（防御性制空）任务。飞机在接受空中加油37,000磅燃料后，于2220Z从约旦的穆瓦法克·萨勒提空军基地（OJMS）起飞。

**UAP Encounter:** 在0021Z-0024Z（1.4a时间），机组人员在FL270高度层的沙达迪（Shaddadi）附近（1.4a位置）收到MFT雷达干扰。在0025Z（1.4a），机组人员在FL240高度层观察到"3个疑似UAP位于沙达迪附近"，并制作了武器系统视频（WSV）。随后在0135Z（1.4a）的观察记录为"观察到1个疑似气球位于沙达迪附近"，高度为FL210，同样制作了WSV。

**Additional Operations:** 该任务涉及多次空中加油，飞机于0134Z从GANDER航线接收33,500磅燃料，于0226Z从GANDER航线接收11,000磅燃料。飞机于0435Z按照ESD（紧急安全距离）程序在OJMS降落。

**Provenance:** 由USCENTCOM参谋长理查德·A·哈里森少将于2025年10月8日解密。文件通过MDR 25-0094至MDR 25-0099 / JS-250710-TM8S发布。

events.title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Composite Sketch
events.record_description: Actual site photo with FBI Lab rendered graphic overlay depicting corroborating eyewitness reports from September 2023 of an apparent ellipsoid bronze metallic object materializing out of a bright light in the sky, 130-195 feet in length, and disappearing instantaneously.
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** FBI Laboratory composite rendering overlaid on actual site photograph, corroborating multiple eyewitness reports.

**Event Summary:** In September 2023, multiple eyewitnesses reported observing an ellipsoid bronze metallic object that materialized out of a bright light in the sky before disappearing instantaneously. The object was described as having a smooth, elliptical profile with bronze or golden metallic coloring.

**Object Characteristics:** Witnesses consistently reported the object's length as between 130-195 feet. The craft appeared suddenly from within an intense bright light source with radiating beams, visible against a clear blue daytime sky. The object's appearance was described as solid and metallic, not translucent or atmospheric in nature.

**Location & Environment:** The sighting occurred over a rural area with open fields and tree lines visible in the background. The photograph shows a paved road, grassy field, and forested area under clear daylight conditions.

**Document Provenance:** This composite image was produced by the FBI Laboratory to visually document and standardize the multiple corroborating eyewitness descriptions. The rendering depicts the object's position, size relationship to the landscape, and the characteristic bright light phenomenon associated with its appearance.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type:** FBI实验室合成渲染图叠加在实际现场照片上,印证了多名目击者的报告。

**Event Summary:** 2023年9月,多名目击者报告观察到一个椭球形青铜金属物体从天空中的明亮光源中显现,随后瞬间消失。该物体被描述为具有光滑的椭圆形轮廓,呈青铜色或金色金属色泽。

**Object Characteristics:** 目击者一致报告该物体长度在130-195英尺之间。该飞行器突然从一个伴有辐射光束的强烈明亮光源中出现,在晴朗的白天蓝色天空中清晰可见。物体外观被描述为坚实的金属质感,而非半透明或大气现象性质。

**Location & Environment:** 目击事件发生在一个乡村地区上空,背景可见开阔田野和树木林线。照片显示了铺设的道路、草地和树林区域,处于晴朗的日光条件下。

**Document Provenance:** 该合成图像由FBI实验室制作,用于视觉化记录和标准化多个相互印证的目击者描述。该渲染图描绘了物体的位置、与地貌的尺寸关系,以及与其出现相关联的特征性明亮光现象。

events.title: FBI 302 Interview - UAP Sighting at LIDAR Test Site
events.record_description: This is an FBI 302 interview conducted with a US citizen regarding their first-hand account of a UAP encounter at a US test site.  USPER described an object "metallic bronze in color."
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** FBI FD-302 interview report (Rev. 5-8-10), date of entry 10/12/2023, date drafted 10/10/2023.

**Parties Involved:** FBI Special Agent interviewed a U.S. person via Facetime video on September 1, 2023. The witness was accompanied by two other individuals during the incident.

**Incident Summary:** On September 1, 2023, at approximately 9:00 am, the witness and companions were driving east to a test site to acquire data for LIDAR testing. They were traveling in three vehicles: the witness driving an F150, another person behind them driving a GMC AT4, and a third person driving a sprinter van.

**Object Description:** As the vehicles drove through a couple of gates, the witness observed a bright light over the horizon. The stationary light was in the sky, moving to the right before disappearing. The witness could see the light through the top right of the vehicle's windshield. The light was bright white and remained visible for ten seconds before disappearing. It maintained the same size throughout the incident. The light was estimated to be ten to twenty miles away.

**Witness Observations:** The witness did not notice any interference with his vehicle. When another person pointed the light out to the witness, he looked in the wrong direction. The witness was also tall with his seat leaned back, limiting his ability to see the light initially. He remained indifferent to the light until they reached the first test site, where others confirmed they had also observed it.

**Investigation Context:** This interview was conducted at a U.S. test site location; the witness reported the object as metallic bronze in color (per official description).
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type:** FBI FD-302访谈报告(修订版5-8-10),录入日期2023年10月12日,起草日期2023年10月10日。

**涉及方:** FBI特别探员于2023年9月1日通过Facetime视频采访了一名美国公民。目击者在事件发生时有另外两人陪同。

**事件摘要:** 2023年9月1日,大约上午9:00,目击者和同伴正驾车向东前往一个测试场地,以获取LIDAR(激光雷达)测试数据。他们驾驶三辆车:目击者驾驶一辆F150,另一人在后面驾驶GMC AT4,第三人驾驶一辆sprinter厢式车。

**Object Description:** 当车辆驶过几道门时,目击者观察到地平线上方有一道明亮的光。这道静止的光在天空中,向右移动后消失。目击者能够通过车辆挡风玻璃的右上方看到这道光。光呈明亮的白色,在消失前保持可见约十秒钟。在整个事件期间,它的大小保持不变。据估计,这道光距离约十到二十英里远。

**Witness Observations:** 目击者没有注意到他的车辆受到任何干扰。当另一人向目击者指出这道光时,他看错了方向。目击者个子较高且座椅向后倾斜,这限制了他最初看到光的能力。他对这道光保持漠不关心的态度,直到他们到达第一个测试地点,其他人确认他们也观察到了它。

**Investigation Context:** 此次访谈在美国一处测试场地进行;目击者报告该物体呈金属青铜色(依据官方描述)。

events.title: FBI Interview: UAP Sighting at Restricted Test Site Gate
events.record_description: This is an FBI 302 interview conducted with a US citizen regarding their first-hand account of a UAP encounter at a US test site. USPER described an object "metallic/gray in color."
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** FBI FD-302 interview report, dated 10/10/2023, documenting a first-hand UAP encounter at a restricted U.S. test site.

**Parties Involved:** Interview conducted by FBI Special Agents with a U.S. citizen contractor who had worked at the test site for several years. The witness was accompanied by their supervisor during the interview at an FBI office.

**Incident Summary:** On September 27, 2023, at approximately 7:15–7:30 AM, the witness was working with contractors on a special project at a restricted test site. Three vehicles transported the contractors to the site. The witness drove the first vehicle with another person as front passenger; two additional contractors were in the second and third vehicles.

**Key Details:** As the witness drove through a gate that restricted access to part of the test site, they attempted to open the gate remotely using a fob. The gate opened partially then closed on three separate attempts. On the fourth attempt, the gate opened completely and remained open. The witness looked up while driving through the gate and observed an object described as metallic/gray in color. There were no prior operational problems with that particular gate, and no operational issues occurred after September 2023.

**Provenance:** Official FBI record, entry date 10/10/2023, drafted 10/10/2023.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type:** FBI FD-302访谈报告,日期为2023年10月10日,记录了在美国一处限制区域试验场地的第一手UAP遭遇事件。

**Parties Involved:** 访谈由FBI特别探员对一名美国公民承包商进行,该承包商已在试验场地工作数年。证人在FBI办公室接受访谈时由其主管陪同。

**Incident Summary:** 2023年9月27日,大约上午7:15至7:30,证人正与承包商在一处限制区域试验场地从事一个特殊项目。三辆车将承包商运送至该场地。证人驾驶第一辆车,另一人坐在前排乘客位置;另外两名承包商分别在第二辆和第三辆车内。

**Key Details:** 当证人驾车通过一道限制进入试验场地部分区域的大门时,他们尝试使用遥控钥匙远程打开大门。大门在三次独立尝试中都是部分打开后又关闭。第四次尝试时,大门完全打开并保持开启状态。证人在驾车通过大门时抬头看,观察到一个被描述为金属/灰色的物体。该特定大门此前没有出现过操作问题,2023年9月之后也未发生操作故障。

**Provenance:** FBI官方记录,录入日期2023年10月10日,起草日期2023年10月10日。

events.title: FBI FD-302: Drone Pilot Sighting at LiDAR Test Site, September 2023
events.record_description: This is an FBI 302 interview conducted with a US citizen regarding their first-hand account of a UAP encounter at a US test site. USPER described a "bright light over the horizon."
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** FBI FD-302 interview report (FD-302 Rev. 5-8-10), dated 10/10/2023, documenting a first-hand UAP sighting by a U.S. person.

**Parties Involved:** FBI Special Agent interviewed a witness (identity redacted) via FaceTime video on September [redacted], 2023. The witness is a licensed drone pilot with 10–15 hours of experience flying drones, employed in the drone industry.

**Incident Summary:** On September [redacted], 2023, the witness was at a test site with three other contractors conducting LiDAR tests. After receiving a briefing, five individuals got into three vehicles around 7:30 am and drove south. The sun was in the east with good visibility.

**Key Details:** At approximately three-quarters windshield height, the witness saw a linear object with a super-bright light at the east side. The light was bright white and intense enough to see bands within it. The object was metallic/gray, had no wings or exhaust, and was smaller than a 737—roughly one to two Blackhawk helicopters in length. It was distinctly larger than a drone, approximately 5,000 feet above ground level, and moved east to west parallel to the ground. The object was visible for 5–10 seconds before the light went out and it vanished. The sky was clear; the witness and others could not locate the object again.

**Document Provenance:** Official FBI record, date of entry 10/10/2023, drafted 10/10/2023. Investigation conducted in the United States (Facetime video). File number redacted.
events.report_summary_zh:

**相关方:** FBI特别探员于2023年9月[已编辑]日通过FaceTime视频采访了一名证人(身份已编辑)。该证人是持证无人机飞行员,拥有10-15小时的无人机飞行经验,就职于无人机行业。

**事件概要:** 2023年9月[已编辑]日,证人与其他三名承包商在一个测试场地进行LiDAR(激光雷达)测试。在接受简报后,五个人在上午7点30分左右登上三辆车并向南行驶。当时太阳在东方,能见度良好。

**关键细节:** 大约在挡风玻璃高度的四分之三处,证人看到一个线性物体,其东侧有一个超级明亮的光源。该光源呈明亮的白色,强度足以看到其中的光带。该物体呈金属/灰色,没有机翼或排气,比737客机小——长度大约相当于一到两架黑鹰直升机。它明显大于无人机,距地面约5,000英尺,平行于地面从东向西移动。该物体可见时间为5-10秒,之后光源熄灭并消失。天空晴朗;证人和其他人无法再次找到该物体。

**文件来源:** FBI官方记录,录入日期2023年10月10日,起草日期2023年10月10日。调查在美国境内进行(FaceTime视频)。文件编号已编辑。

This document is a Mission Report (MISREP), a standardized reporting form the U.S. Military uses to record the circumstances surrounding its operations. U.S. military services often use MISREPs to report Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) to AARO. The GENTEXT, or “general text” section of these reports often contains important qualitative, contextual information, distinguishing it from the more quantitative, or numerical, data found elsewhere in the report.
A U.S. military operator reported observing a UAP “flying just above the surface of the ocean.” The report describes the UAP as taking “multiple 90-degree turns at an estimated 80 mph.”
All descriptive and estimative language contained in this report reflects the reporter’s subjective interpretation at the time of the event. Such characterizations should not be interpreted as a conclusive indication of the presence or absence of any intrinsic object features or performance characteristics.
events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Mission Report (MISREP 9329374), declassified 22 January 2026 by USCENTCOM Chief of Staff.

**Mission Details:** On 27 October 2023, an aerial ISR platform (1.4a) launched at 2339Z from LGLR and was handed over from the Launch and Recovery Element (LRE) at 2352Z. The platform proceeded to its tasking area to support classified operations, arriving on-station at 0342Z. The crew performed FMV/SIGINT collection at 36S YC 4d (coordinates redacted) per ISR tasking.

**UAP Observation:** At 0035Z, the crew observed one possible UAP (documented as "1X POSS UAP" in the narrative). The sighting occurred during active mission operations in the Aegean Sea region, under USCENTCOM / AFSOC command authority, operating from the 603rd Operations Center.

**Mission Completion:** The platform returned to base at 1011Z, was handed back to the LRE at 1213Z, and landed at OJMS at 1309Z. Full motion video was exploited by 1330 mission hours. Total mission duration: 06:29 FMV hours, with one FMV tasking prosecuted.

**Classification:** Originally classified; declassification date 20481026. Operations conducted in the AIR domain under AFSOC / USCENTCOM authority. Document approved for public release to AARO per MDR 26-0019.

events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Mission Report (MISREP 9337873) documenting a U.S. military Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) operation that included an unidentified aerial phenomena observation.

**Operation Details:** Conducted by the 603rd Operations Center under AFSOC (Air Force Special Operations Command) and USCENTCOM (U.S. Central Command) in the Aegean Sea region. The mission involved full motion video collection over approximately 9 hours and 24 minutes, with 1 hour of FMV taskings prosecuted.

**Timeline:** The mission began at 1504Z with takeoff from LGLR (Larissa Air Base, Greece), transitioning to LRBE (Beirut, Lebanon) for fragged tasking to support data masked operations. At 1618Z, the aircraft was 7-lined to support data masked operations and arrived on-station at 2018Z. FMV/SIGINT collection was performed at 36S YC 40. At 0811Z, the crew observed 1x possible UAP (referenced as "UAP 1"). The aircraft returned to base at 0542Z, handed back to LRBE at 1035Z, and landed at LGLR at 1105Z.

**UAP Observation:** One unidentified anomalous phenomenon was observed during the mission at 0811Z. The encounter occurred during active ISR operations in the vicinity of coordinates 36S YC 40.

**Document Provenance:** Declassified by MG Richard A. Harrison, USCENTCOM Chief of Staff, on 22 January 2026. Originally classified with associated caveats. Declassification date: 20481028 (2048-10-28). Document approved for release to AARO (All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office) per USCENTCOM MDR 26-0019, dated 01/26/26.
events.report_summary_zh:

events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

Mission Report (MISREP undefined-9319618) documenting a U.S. military UAP observation during operations in the Arabian Gulf region, declassified September 12, 2025.

**Operational Timeline**

The narrative details multiple military activities between 0015Z and 2058Z on October 31, 2023. Key events include: departure from Al Dhafra (OMAM) at 0015Z, handover from LRE at 0030Z, professional guard call received at 0145Z, and SIGINT collection via airhandler from 0150Z to 2019Z. The operator was on station in SRO track Irish Sickle at 0155Z and conducted IMINT ISO operation Spartan Shield from 0155Z to 1837Z.

**UAP Observations**

Two distinct UAP observations occurred: at 0241Z the operator observed one UAP (see UAP Line 1), and at 0322Z observed one UAP (see UAP Line 2). The platform was cleared to return to base at 1837Z, went off station at 1912Z, was handed back to LRE at 2019Z, and landed at OMAM at 2058Z where the FMV was exploited by DGS-2.

**Document Provenance**

Approved for release to AARO under USCENTCOM MDR 25-0104, this standardized military reporting form captures both quantitative data and qualitative contextual information about UAP encounters during combat operations.

**Document Type:** U.S. Military Mission Report (MISREP 9381202) documenting an unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP) encounter during military operations.

**Event Summary:** At 2153Z, a U.S. military operator observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon at 37 degrees (direction) and 69 nautical miles distance while operating a UAP-1 platform. The sighting occurred during a mission that began at 0217Z and involved data-masked tasking operations.

**Mission Timeline:** The operator departed at 0217Z and proceeded to fragged tasking to support data-masked operations. At 0217Z, the operator was 7-lined to support data masked operations but did not arrive on-station at 38S MB 48. The operator arrived on-station at 0355Z at location 0431Z, checked in with data masked personnel, and performed FMV/SIGINT collection at 37S FU 81. Similar collection activities were conducted at 0539Z at location 0805Z. At 1933Z, the operator returned to base, landing at 2319Z after handing back control at 2254Z.

**Key Details:** Full motion video was exploited by data-masked personnel. The document contains multiple redacted sections marked as "SECRET//NOFORN" indicating classified and foreign-disclosure-restricted information.

**Document Provenance:** Recommended by MG Brandon R. Tegtmeier, USCENTCOM Chief of Staff, on 2 June 2025. Approved for release to AARO by USCENTCOM MDR 25-0072 on 06/02/2025.

events.title: MISREP: Aerial Phenomenon Observed During Weapons Calibration, Iraq
events.record_description:

The GENTEXT, or “general text” section of these reports often contains important qualitative, contextual information, distinguishing it from the more quantitative, or numerical, data found elsewhere in the report.
While conducting a weapons calibration test, U.S. military operators reported observing a lens flare via MX-20 and MX-25 IR sensors after firing an AGM-176 Griffin air-to-surface missile. The operators described the source of the flare as a UAP moving through the aircraft’s sensor’s field-of-view at a high rate of speed. The reporter assessed that the flare was associated with “a significant heat source.”

events.report_summary:
**Document Type:** Mission Report (MISREP undefined-10431840), SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY, declassified 24 October 2025.

**Mission Details:** On 20 September 2024, U.S. military aircraft IVO 38SKC6 departed Okas, Iraq at 1740Z and arrived on station at approximately 1930Z to conduct a weapons calibration test. The crew performed a weapons calibration having released 20x105mm, 101x30mm, and 1xAGM-176 munitions.

**Observation:** During a PGM (Precision Guided Munition) shot, the crew observed an unidentified aerial phenomena. The aircraft was cleared off station at 2329Z with the intent to meet and landed at Okas at 0046Z.

**Operations Context:** The mission was conducted by SOTU 016 under the 609th Operations Center as part of INHERENT RESOLVE operations. Major Command: AFSOC. Combatant Command: USCENTCOM.

**Assessment:** According to AARO analysis, operators reported observing a lens flare via MX-20 and MX-25 IR sensors after firing an AGM-176 Griffin air-to-surface missile, describing the source as a UAP moving through the sensor's field-of-view at high speed, associated with "a significant heat source."

**Observation:** 在进行PGM(精确制导弹药)发射期间，机组人员观察到不明空中现象。飞机于2329Z获准离开任务区域，意图会合并于0046Z降落在奥卡斯。

**Operations Context:** 该任务由SOTU 016在609作战中心指挥下执行，属于INHERENT RESOLVE行动的一部分。主要司令部：AFSOC。作战司令部：USCENTCOM。

**Document Type**

Classified Mission Report (MISREP undefined-10541508), SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY, declassified 24 October 2025. Submitted by USCENTCOM MDR 25-0100 thru 25-0103 / JS-250710-TM88.

**Mission Overview**

At 0823Z on 20 October 2024, an ISR platform departed OJMS via SLR and proceeded to fragged tasking. The aircraft (7-lined) performed FMV/SIGINT collection operations at multiple stations throughout Syria, executing ISR collections at 37S FV 86 (ISR 1), 37S FU 16 (ISR 2), and 37S FU 88 (ISR 3). Mission duration: 20:24 hours total, with 14:22 FMV hours, 3X FMV taskings prosecuted, 13:02 SIGINT hours, and 3X SIGINT taskings.

**UAP Observation**

At 1559Z, the operator observed an unidentified arrival phenomenon (referenced as UAP 1). The phenomenon was described in the associated report as a "misshapen and uneven ball of white light" with multiple "glares or light" from an "unknown origin," appearing as a "light/glare halo effect" at the top of the Full-Motion Video feed.

**Mission Conclusion**

At 0124Z the following day, the platform returned to base. At 0447Z, it conducted SLR and landed at OJMS. Full motion video was exploited by the Common Ground Element (CET).

**Key Details:** 往来信件表明这对相关人员来说是"第一次",暗示这是新颖的程序处理方式。该批准被描述为基于所提供的摘要,请求按UNCLASSIFIED(非机密)级别处理。发件人向收件人提供进一步协助。

events.title: Apollo 12 Air-to-Ground Voice Transcript - Unidentified Phenomena Observations
events.source: NASA Apollo Mission — NASA-UAP-D1, Apollo 12 Transcript, 1969
events.record_description:
Apollo 12 was the fourth crewed U.S. mission to the Moon and the second to land astronauts on the lunar surface. This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 12 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription, November 1969, highlighting two periods in which astronauts reported observing unidentified phenomenon: a one hour period on the fifth day, and a two minute period on the sixth day. These transcripts contain contemporaneous observations by the flight crew reacting to unidentified phenomenon.
•	Day 05, Hour 19, Minute 14, Second 58 through Day 05, Hour 20, Minute 12, Second 14:
o	At 05:19:27:25, the pilot of the Lunar Module (LMP-LM), Astronaut Alan L. Bean, described observing particles and flashes of light “sailing off in space” via the onboard Alignment Optical Telescope (AOT). He characterized these phenomenon as “escaping the Moon.”
•	Day 06, Hour 00, Minute 21, Second 42 through Day 06, Hour 00, Minute 23, Second 33:
o	Mission Commander, Charles “Pete” Conrad, described observing floating debris outside the lunar module, which had been illuminated by the module’s onboard tracking light. At 06:00:21:51, Conrad assessed that the tracking light had burnt out because he could no longer see the debris from the module.
events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

Official NASA Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription excerpt from Apollo 12, the second crewed lunar landing mission, November 1969.

**Parties Involved**

Apollo 12 crew: Commander Charles "Pete" Conrad (CDR), Command Module Pilot (CMP), and Lunar Module Pilot Alan L. Bean (LMP). Communications with Mission Control Houston (CC) and Capsule Communicator (Yankee Clipper).

**Sighting Summary**

Two distinct periods of unidentified phenomenon observations reported by crew during lunar operations. First incident (Day 05, Hour 19-20): Lunar Module Pilot Alan Bean reported observing particles and flashes of light "sailing off in space" through the Alignment Optical Telescope (AOT), describing them as "escaping the Moon." Second incident (Day 06, Hour 00, Minutes 21-23): Commander Conrad observed floating debris outside the lunar module illuminated by the onboard tracking light; light subsequently appeared to burn out at 06:00:21:51.

**Key Details**

Transcript shows routine mission communications interspersed with phenomenon reports. Lift-off time communicated as 142:03:47. Crew reported "POO and ACCEPT" computer states and CSM state vector/RLS updates. References to "Intrepid" (Lunar Module) and "Yankee Clipper" (Command Module). Communications include technical coordination and casual conversation ("couple of coal miners coming up to see you").

**Provenance**

Tape 90/3, Page 142 of official NASA Apollo 12 mission transcription. Document declassified and released as part of NASA UAP-related materials review.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type**

官方NASA技术文件，摘录自阿波罗12号任务的空地语音通讯记录，该任务为第二次载人登月任务，执行于1969年11月。

**Parties Involved**

阿波罗12号机组人员：指令长查尔斯·"皮特"·康拉德(Charles "Pete" Conrad, CDR)、指令舱飞行员(CMP)以及登月舱飞行员艾伦·L·比恩(Alan L. Bean, LMP)。与休斯顿任务控制中心(CC)及太空舱通讯员(Yankee Clipper)进行通讯。

**Sighting Summary**

机组人员在月球作业期间报告了两次不同时段的不明现象观测。第一次事件(第5天，第19-20小时)：登月舱飞行员艾伦·比恩报告通过对准光学望远镜(AOT)观察到颗粒物和闪光"在太空中飘移"，并将其描述为"正在逃离月球"。第二次事件(第6天，第0小时，第21-23分钟)：指令长康拉德观察到登月舱外有漂浮碎片被机载跟踪灯照亮；该灯随后似乎在06:00:21:51时烧毁。

**Key Details**

记录显示常规任务通讯中穿插了现象报告。起飞时间通报为142:03:47。机组报告了"POO and ACCEPT"计算机状态以及CSM状态矢量/RLS更新。提及"Intrepid"(登月舱)和"Yankee Clipper"(指令舱)。通讯内容包括技术协调和随意交谈("两个煤矿工上来看你们")。

**Provenance**

磁带90/3，NASA阿波罗12号任务官方记录第142页。该文件作为NASA UAP相关材料审查的一部分已解密并发布。

events.title: Apollo 17 Transcript: Bright Particles and Flashing Objects During Lunar Mission
events.source: NASA Apollo Mission — NASA-UAP-D2, Apollo 17 Transcript, 1972
events.record_description:
Apollo 17 was the ninth crewed U.S. mission to the Moon, and the sixth to land astronauts on the lunar surface. This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 17 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription, December 1972, highlighting three periods in which astronauts reported observing unidentified phenomenon: a nine minute period on the first day, a three hour period on the second day, and a six minute period on the third day. 
•	Day 00, Hour 03, Minute 34, Second 10 through Day 00, Hour 03, Minute 42, Second 29:
    o	Command Module Pilot (CMP), Ronald Evans, reported observing “very bright particles or fragments” drifting and “tumbling” near the spacecraft as it maneuvered. Lunar Module Pilot (LMP), Harrison “Jack” Schmitt, described the phenomenon as looking “like the Fourth of July.” The astronauts speculated that the phenomenon may be attributable to ice or paint fragments dislodging from a separated component of the spacecraft (S-IVB) but characterized that assessment as a “wild guess.”
•	Day 02, Hour 18, Minute 42, Second 34 through Day 02, Hour 21, Minute 07, Second 05:
    o	Mission Commander, Eugene A. Cernan, reported difficulty sleeping and described having observed “some sets of the streaks.” He also described an intense light flashing between his eyes, describing its intensity as comparable to that of a train headlight and characterizing it as “imposing.” Over the next three hours, Cernan described observing several flashing, rotating phenomenon that he assessed as corresponding to physical objects in space rather than a purely optical phenomenon. LMP Schmitt also reported observing similar phenomenon, though he again assessed the source of his observation to be a separated rocket stage (S-IVB). At 02:20:55:22, Cernan reported observing two additional distant flashing objects, though he assessed them as Spacecraft/Lunar Module Adapter panels (SLA panel), another separated component of the Saturn V rocket.
•	Day 03, Hour 15, Minute 33, Second 25 through Day 03, Hour 15, Minute 39, Second 46:
    o	At 03:15:38:09, LMP Schmitt exclaimed that he had observed a flash on the lunar surface north of Grimaldi (crater).
events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

Excerpt from Apollo 17 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription (Tape 5/2), documenting unidentified visual phenomena observed by astronauts during their lunar mission in December 1972.

**Parties Involved**

Command Module Pilot (CMP) Ronald Evans, Lunar Module Pilot (LMP) Harrison "Jack" Schmitt, Mission Commander Eugene A. Cernan, and Capsule Communicator (CC) at Houston Mission Control.

**Sighting Summary**

At mission elapsed time 00:03:34:10, during spacecraft maneuvering, CMP Evans reported observing "a few very bright particles or fragments or something that go drifting by as we maneuver." LMP Schmitt described "a whole bunch of big ones on my window down there - just bright. It looks like the Fourth of July out of Ron's window." Evans clarified: "Now you can see some of them in shape. They're very jagged, angular fragments that are tumbling."

**Key Details**

The observations occurred approximately 3 hours and 34 minutes into the mission, at spacecraft separation event time of 03:33:27. Cabin pressure was recorded at 5.9 PSI. The astronauts discussed the phenomenon while conducting maneuvers, with spacecraft SEP time planned for 03:43. Crew speculated the objects might be ice or paint fragments from the separated S-IVB stage, but characterized this as a "wild guess."

**Document Provenance**

Official NASA mission transcript, declassified and released as part of NASA-UAP-D2 collection.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type**

摘录自阿波罗17号技术空地通话语音记录(磁带5/2)，记录了1972年12月宇航员在月球任务期间观察到的不明视觉现象。

**Parties Involved**

指令舱飞行员(CMP)罗纳德·埃文斯(Ronald Evans)、登月舱飞行员(LMP)哈里森·"杰克"·施密特(Harrison "Jack" Schmitt)、任务指令长尤金·A·塞尔南(Eugene A. Cernan)，以及休斯顿任务控制中心的太空舱通讯员(CC)。

**Sighting Summary**

在任务经过时间00:03:34:10，航天器机动过程中，CMP埃文斯报告观察到"一些非常明亮的粒子或碎片之类的东西在我们机动时漂过"。LMP施密特描述道："我窗户下面有一大堆大的——非常明亮。从罗恩的窗户看出去就像国庆烟火一样。"埃文斯进一步说明："现在你能看到它们中一些的形状。它们是非常参差不齐、有棱角的碎片，正在翻滚。"

**Key Details**

观测发生在任务开始后约3小时34分钟，航天器分离事件时间为03:33:27。记录的座舱压力为5.9 PSI。宇航员在执行机动操作时讨论了这一现象，航天器分离时间计划在03:43。机组人员推测这些物体可能是来自已分离的S-IVB级的冰或油漆碎片，但将此定性为"胡乱猜测"。

**Document Provenance**

NASA官方任务记录誊本，作为NASA-UAP-D2收藏的一部分解密并发布。

events.title: Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing (U) - Unusual Observations
events.source: NASA Apollo Mission — NASA-UAP-D4, Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1969
events.record_description:
Apollo 11 was the third crewed mission to the Moon and the first to land Astronauts on the lunar surface. This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing (Volumes 1 and 2) from July 31, 1969. The document highlights three observations: one, an object on the way out to the Moon; two, flashes of light inside the cabin; and three, a sighting on the return trip of a bright light tentatively assumed by the crew to be a laser.

•	Page 6-33 (Vol. 1). [Lunar Module Pilot for Apollo 11, Buzz Aldrin]: “The first unusual thing that we saw I guess was 1 day out or something pretty close to the moon. It had a sizeable dimension to it, so we put the monocular on it.” The crew speculated that it could have been the S-IVB stage of the Saturn V launch vehicle.
•	Page 6-37 (Vol. 1). [Lunar Module Pilot for Apollo 11, Buzz Aldrin] “The other observation that I made accumulated gradually. I don’t know whether I saw it the first night, but I’m sure I saw it the second night. I was trying to go to sleep with all the lights out. I observed what I thought were little flashes inside the cabin, spaced a couple of minutes apart…”
•	Page 21-1 (Vol. 2). [Lunar Module Pilot for Apollo 11, Buzz Aldrin] “I observed what appeared to be a fairly bright light source which we tentatively ascribed to a possible laser.”
events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

NASA classified technical crew debriefing document (GROUP 4, downgraded at 3-year intervals; declassified after 12 years). Volume 1 of a two-volume set prepared by Mission Operations Branch, Flight Crew Support Division.

**Mission Context**

Apollo 11, the first crewed lunar landing mission, launched July 16, 1969. Crew: Neil Armstrong (Commander), Buzz Aldrin (Lunar Module Pilot), Michael Collins (Command Module Pilot). This debriefing was conducted July 31, 1969, shortly after the crew's return.

**Observation 1: Object En Route to Moon (Day 1)**

Lunar Module Pilot Buzz Aldrin reported observing an unusual object approximately one day out from Earth, en route to the Moon. The object had "sizeable dimension," prompting the crew to observe it through a monocular. The crew speculated it could have been the S-IVB stage of their Saturn V launch vehicle (page 6-33, Vol. 1).

**Observation 2: Interior Light Flashes**

Aldrin reported seeing "little flashes inside the cabin" while attempting to sleep with all lights extinguished. The flashes occurred at intervals of several minutes apart, observed on at least the second night of the mission (page 6-37, Vol. 1).

**Observation 3: Bright Light Source on Return**

During the return trip from the Moon, Aldrin observed "a fairly bright light source" which the crew tentatively attributed to a possible laser (page 21-1, Vol. 2).

**Document Provenance**

Originally classified CONFIDENTIAL under NASA Policy Directive 1382.2, subject to Freedom of Information Act review provisions (5 U.S.C. 552). Document bears handwritten annotations and clearance stamps.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type**

NASA机密技术乘组任务汇报文件(第4组,每3年降级一次;12年后解密)。由任务操作处飞行乘组支持部准备的两卷本文件中的第1卷。

**Mission Context**

阿波罗11号是首次载人登月任务,于1969年7月16日发射。乘组成员:尼尔·阿姆斯特朗(Neil Armstrong,指令长)、巴兹·奥尔德林(Buzz Aldrin,登月舱飞行员)、迈克尔·柯林斯(Michael Collins,指令舱飞行员)。此次任务汇报于1969年7月31日进行,即乘组返回后不久。

**Observation 1: Object En Route to Moon (Day 1)**

登月舱飞行员巴兹·奥尔德林报告称,在离开地球约一天后、前往月球途中观察到一个异常物体。该物体具有"相当大的尺寸",促使乘组通过单筒望远镜对其进行观察。乘组推测该物体可能是他们土星五号运载火箭的S-IVB级(第1卷第6-33页)。

**Observation 2: Interior Light Flashes**

奥尔德林报告称,在熄灭所有灯光尝试睡眠时,看到"座舱内的小闪光"。这些闪光每隔几分钟出现一次,至少在任务的第二个夜晚观察到(第1卷第6-37页)。

**Observation 3: Bright Light Source on Return**

在从月球返回途中,奥尔德林观察到"一个相当明亮的光源",乘组初步将其归因于可能的激光(第2卷第21-1页)。

**Document Provenance**

该文件原依据NASA政策指令1382.2被列为机密(CONFIDENTIAL),受《信息自由法》审查条款约束(美国法典第5编第552条)。文件上有手写注释和审批印章。

events.title: Apollo 17 Crew Debriefing for Science - Unexpected UV Background Radiation
events.source: NASA Apollo Mission — NASA-UAP-D5, Apollo 17 Crew Debriefing for Science, 1973
events.record_description:
Apollo 17 was the ninth crewed U.S. mission to the Moon, and the sixth to land Astronauts on the lunar surface. This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 17 Crew Debriefing for Science on January 8, 1973, in which Dick Henry, co-investigator on the ultraviolet experiment on Apollo 17, discusses seeing results that were unexpected. 
•	Pages 119-120. “One of the most exciting results of X-ray astronomy was the fact that an X-ray background was observed over the sky that nobody had expected, and part of this is the gamma-ray background that Dr. Trombka talked about. In the UV, nobody knows, but you never know until you look. You do have to deal with this background of stars that we know is there. So, we did look at a large number of different points at high galactic latitudes, both north and south. The spectrum that we see is above this dark count. In other words, this abnormally high dark current did not, in fact, interfere with that experiment. The spectrum that we see looks like the spectrum of the hot star; however, we know that there were no hot stars within our field of view. Therefore, the most conservative interpretation, I think, is that what we're seeing is light from hot stars in the galactic plane going up out of the plane and reflecting off interstellar dust. There are certain characteristics of the spectrum, though, that don't fit that theory, and it's at least possible that this is extragalactic radiation. I'm looking forward very much to the detailed computer study of this, but it's going to take a long time.”
events.report_summary:
**Document Type**
NASA crew debriefing transcript, document MSC-07632, prepared by the Science Requirements Branch, Planetary and Earth Sciences Division, Manned Spacecraft Center, Houston, Texas.

**Parties Involved**
Apollo 17 crew and Dick Henry, co-investigator on the ultraviolet experiment conducted during the Apollo 17 lunar mission (December 1972).

**Event Summary**
During the debriefing held on January 8, 1973, Dick Henry discussed unexpected results from the ultraviolet astronomy experiment flown on Apollo 17. The experiment observed multiple points at high galactic latitudes (both north and south) and detected an unexplained ultraviolet background spectrum above the normal dark count.

**Key Details**
The observed UV spectrum resembled that of a hot star, yet no hot stars were present within the instrument's field of view. Henry proposed the most conservative interpretation: the signal might be light from hot stars in the galactic plane reflecting off interstellar dust outside the plane. However, he noted that certain spectral characteristics did not fit this theory, leaving open the possibility that the radiation could be extragalactic in origin. Henry emphasized the need for detailed computer analysis, which he anticipated would take considerable time. He drew parallels to X-ray astronomy, where unexpected background radiation had previously led to significant discoveries.

**Document Provenance**
Official NASA mission debriefing record, indexed MSC M52-071232, archived at the Manned Spacecraft Center.
events.title_ocr_original: NASA-UAP-D5, Apollo 17 Crew Debriefing for Science, 1973
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type**
NASA机组任务汇报记录誊本，文件编号MSC-07632，由载人航天器中心(Manned Spacecraft Center)行星与地球科学部科学需求分部编制，德克萨斯州休斯顿。

**Parties Involved**
阿波罗17号(Apollo 17)机组成员和迪克·亨利(Dick Henry)，亨利是阿波罗17号月球任务(1972年12月)期间紫外线实验的联合研究员。

**Event Summary**
在1973年1月8日举行的任务汇报会上，迪克·亨利讨论了阿波罗17号搭载的紫外线天文学实验的意外结果。该实验观测了银河系高纬度地区(北半球和南半球)的多个点，探测到一个无法解释的紫外线背景光谱，其强度高于正常的暗计数。

**Key Details**
观测到的紫外线光谱类似于热星的光谱，但在仪器视场内并没有热星存在。亨利提出了最保守的解释：该信号可能是银河系平面内的热星发出的光，经由平面外的星际尘埃反射而来。然而，他指出某些光谱特征与这一理论不符，因此不排除该辐射可能来自河外星系的可能性。亨利强调需要进行详细的计算机分析，他预计这将需要相当长的时间。他将此情况与X射线天文学进行了类比，在X射线天文学中，意外的背景辐射此前曾导致重大发现。

**Document Provenance**
NASA官方任务汇报记录，索引编号MSC M52-071232，存档于载人航天器中心。

events.title: Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing (U)
events.source: NASA Apollo Mission — NASA-UAP-D6, Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1973
events.record_description:
Apollo 17 was the ninth crewed U.S. mission to the Moon, and the sixth to land Astronauts on the lunar surface. This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing on January 4, 1973, in which astronaut Harrison Schmitt reported seeing light flashes.
•	Page 24-4. [Lunar Module Pilot Harrison Schmitt]: “We had light flashes just about continuously during the whole flight when we were dark adapted. I had one which I thought was a flash on the lunar surface. That one period of time when we had the blindfolds on for the ALFMED [Apollo Light Flash Moving Emulsion Detector] experiment there were just no visible flashes, although that evening, that night, before I went to sleep, I noticed that I was seeing the light flashes again.”
events.report_summary:
**Document Type**

NASA Technical Crew Debriefing, originally classified CONFIDENTIAL, declassified per E.O. 11526 Sec 3(a) on an unspecified date. Document MSC-07631 prepared by the Training Office, Crew Training and Simulation Division, Manned Spacecraft Center, Houston, Texas.

**Mission Context**

Apollo 17 was the ninth crewed U.S. mission to the Moon and the sixth lunar landing mission. The technical debriefing was conducted on January 4, 1973, following the crew's return from the mission in December 1972.

**Sighting Summary**

Lunar Module Pilot Harrison Schmitt reported observing light flashes continuously throughout the flight when dark-adapted. He specifically noted one flash he believed occurred on the lunar surface itself. During a controlled experiment with the Apollo Light Flash Moving Emulsion Detector (ALFMED) using blindfolds, no visible flashes were observed. However, Schmitt reported seeing light flashes again that evening before sleep.

**Key Details**

The phenomenon of light flashes seen by astronauts in space has been documented on multiple Apollo missions. The ALFMED experiment was designed specifically to study these occurrences, which are now understood to be caused by cosmic ray particles passing through the astronauts' eyes and optic nerves.

**Document Provenance**

This is page 24-4 from the complete Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing. The document was automatically declassified 90 days from publication date and is exempt from public disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. 552) with handling governed by NASA Policy Directive 1382.2.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Document Type**

NASA技术乘组任务汇报，原密级为机密(CONFIDENTIAL)，根据第11526号行政命令第3(a)条于未指定日期解密。文件编号MSC-07631，由载人航天中心训练办公室、乘组训练与模拟部门编制，地点位于德克萨斯州休斯顿。

**Mission Context**

阿波罗17号是美国第九次载人登月任务，也是第六次月球着陆任务。此次技术汇报于1973年1月4日进行，时值乘组于1972年12月完成任务返回地球之后。

**Sighting Summary**

登月舱飞行员哈里森·施密特(Harrison Schmitt)报告称，在暗适应状态下，整个飞行过程中持续观察到闪光现象。他特别指出有一次闪光他认为发生在月球表面本身。在使用眼罩进行阿波罗闪光移动乳剂探测器(ALFMED)的受控实验期间，未观察到可见闪光。然而，施密特报告称当晚睡前再次看到了光闪现象。

**Key Details**

宇航员在太空中看到光闪的现象已在多次阿波罗任务中被记录。ALFMED实验专门设计用于研究这些现象，现已明确这些闪光是由宇宙射线粒子穿过宇航员眼睛和视神经引起的。

**Document Provenance**

这是阿波罗17号技术乘组任务汇报完整文件的第24-4页。该文件自发布之日起90天后自动解密，根据《信息自由法》(美国法典第5编第552条)豁免公开披露，文件处理受NASA政策指令1382.2管辖。

events.title: Apollo 12 Lunar Surface Unidentified Phenomena
events.record_description:
This archival photograph depicts the lunar surface as viewed from the landing site of Apollo 12. This image features a highlighted area of interest slightly to the right of the vertical axis of the frame, above the horizon, in which unidentified phenomena are visible. 

This image has been modified from its original state to assist viewers in identifying specific areas of interest. These highlights are provided for contextual purposes only. Such alterations do not constitute an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination regarding the nature or significance of the subject matter.
events.report_summary:
**Mission Context**

This archival photograph was captured during the Apollo 12 mission, the second crewed lunar landing, which occurred in November 1969. The image depicts the lunar surface from the landing site, with the lunar module's equipment visible in the foreground casting a distinctive shadow.

**Anomalous Feature**

The document highlights an unidentified phenomenon visible above the lunar horizon in the upper right portion of the frame. Yellow overlay annotations draw attention to a small area of interest and provide an enlarged inset view showing what appears to be a vertical blue-tinted anomaly or object against the black space background. The enlarged section reveals what could be interpreted as a structured or columnar form with internal detail.

**Official Position**

NASA's description carefully notes that the highlighted areas are provided "for contextual purposes only" and explicitly states that such alterations "do not constitute an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination regarding the nature or significance of the subject matter." This neutral framing suggests the phenomenon remains officially unexplained.

**Visual Characteristics**

The anomaly appears as a distinct blue luminous feature with apparent internal structure or segmentation when magnified. Its position above the stark lunar horizon and contrast against the black void of space make it readily distinguishable from the lunar surface features below.
events.report_summary_zh:
**任务背景**

这张档案照片拍摄于阿波罗12号任务期间，这是第二次载人登月任务，发生在1969年11月。图像展示了从着陆点拍摄的月球表面，前景中可见月球着陆舱的设备投射出独特的阴影。

**异常特征**

该文件突出显示了在画面右上部分月球地平线上方可见的一个不明现象。黄色叠加标注引起人们对一小块感兴趣区域的关注，并提供了一个放大的插图视图，显示了在黑色太空背景下似乎是一个垂直的蓝色调异常或物体。放大部分显示的内容可以被解读为具有内部细节的结构化或柱状形态。

**官方立场**

NASA的描述谨慎地指出，突出显示的区域"仅用于提供背景信息"，并明确表示此类标注"不构成关于主题性质或重要性的分析判断、调查结论或事实认定"。这种中立的表述表明该现象在官方层面仍未得到解释。

**视觉特征**

该异常现象呈现为一个明显的蓝色发光特征，放大后显示出明显的内部结构或分段。它位于荒凉的月球地平线上方，与太空的黑色虚空形成对比,使其很容易与下方的月球表面特征区分开来。

events.title: Apollo 12 Lunar Surface Anomalies - Areas 1 & 2
events.record_description:

This image features two highlighted areas of interest, labeled “Area 1” and “Area 2,” slightly to the right of the vertical axis of the frame, above the horizon, in which unidentified phenomena are visible.

This image has been modified from its original state to assist viewers in identifying specific areas of interest. These highlights are provided for contextual purposes only. Such alterations do not constitute an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination regarding the nature or significance of the subject matter.
events.report_summary:
**Mission Context**

This archival photograph was captured during the Apollo 12 mission in November 1969, the second crewed lunar landing. The image shows the lunar surface from the landing site with the astronaut's shadow visible in the foreground against the stark, gray terrain.

**Highlighted Anomalies**

Two distinct areas have been marked for analysis in the sky above the lunar horizon. Area 1 (upper left) and Area 2 (upper right) contain unidentified phenomena that warranted official documentation. The areas are connected by diagonal lines to two smaller magnified sections at the bottom of the highlighted region, suggesting objects or features of interest were detected in the lunar sky.

**Image Modification Notice**

The photograph has been officially modified from its original state with yellow overlay boxes and connecting lines to direct viewer attention to specific zones. These geometric highlights are explicitly noted as contextual aids only and do not represent analytical conclusions about the nature of the observed phenomena.

**Documentation Significance**

The formal archival preservation of this image with designated areas of interest suggests these anomalies were considered significant enough for official UAP documentation purposes, though no determination regarding their nature or origin is provided in the available metadata.

events.report_summary:
**Mission Context**

This archival photograph was taken during the Apollo 12 mission in November 1969, the second crewed lunar landing. The image shows the lunar surface from the landing site, with the astronaut's shadow visible in the foreground and characteristic lunar terrain featuring footprints and surface disturbances.

**Highlighted Anomaly**

The document features yellow overlay graphics highlighting two distinct areas of interest. The primary area is a large rectangular region in the upper right portion of the frame, above the lunar horizon against the black sky. A secondary smaller square is highlighted on the left side, connected by diagonal lines suggesting a relationship or zoomed perspective between the two regions. Within the larger highlighted area, there appears to be a small bright object or phenomenon visible against the dark sky.

**Official Position**

NASA's accompanying description emphasizes that unidentified phenomena are visible in the highlighted area slightly left of the vertical axis, above the horizon. The agency explicitly states that the modifications and highlights are provided for contextual purposes only and do not constitute analytical judgments, investigative conclusions, or factual determinations regarding the nature or significance of the observed phenomena.

**Documentation Significance**

This image represents one of the declassified NASA records examining potential unidentified aerial phenomena captured during the Apollo program's lunar surface operations.

这张档案照片拍摄于1969年11月的阿波罗12号任务期间，这是第二次载人登月任务。图像显示了从着陆点拍摄的月球表面，前景中可见宇航员的影子，以及具有特征性的月球地形，包括脚印和表面扰动痕迹。

events.title: Apollo 12 Lunar Surface Unidentified Phenomena - Multiple Areas
events.record_description:
This archival photograph depicts the lunar surface as viewed from the landing site of Apollo 12. This image features five highlighted areas of interest, labeled “Area 1” through “Area 5,” above the horizon, in which unidentified phenomena are visible.
This image has been modified from its original state to assist viewers in identifying specific areas of interest. These highlights are provided for contextual purposes only. Such alterations do not constitute an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination regarding the nature or significance of the subject matter.
events.report_summary:
**Mission Context**

This declassified NASA document presents imagery from the Apollo 12 lunar landing mission in November 1969. The photograph shows the lunar surface from the landing site with five distinct areas highlighted above the horizon where unidentified phenomena were observed.

**Visual Evidence**

The upper portion of the image displays deep space above the lunar horizon with five yellow-outlined rectangular areas labeled "Area 1" through "Area 5." Each area contains visible luminous objects or phenomena against the dark space background. Area 5 shows the most prominent object - a bright, elongated form with distinct structure. Areas 1, 2, 3, and 4 contain smaller but clearly visible points or objects of light. Small reference boxes appear to indicate scale or specific points of interest within each highlighted region.

**Surface Documentation**

The lower portion shows an unmodified Apollo 12 surface photograph depicting the lunar terrain with characteristic shadows, footprints, and disturbed regolith near the landing site. The stark contrast between the bright lunar surface and the completely black sky provides context for the aerial phenomena observed above.

**Official Acknowledgment**

The document explicitly states these highlights identify "unidentified phenomena" visible in the original Apollo 12 photography. NASA's accompanying text carefully notes the modifications are "for contextual purposes only" and do not constitute analytical conclusions about the nature of the observed objects, maintaining official ambiguity while documenting their presence in the historical record.
events.report_summary_zh:
**任务背景**

**视觉证据**

图像上部显示了月球地平线上方的深空，其中有五个黄色轮廓的矩形区域，标记为"区域1"至"区域5"。每个区域都包含在黑暗太空背景下可见的发光物体或现象。区域5显示了最显著的物体——一个明亮、细长的形态,具有明显的结构。区域1、2、3和4包含较小但清晰可见的光点或光体。小参考框似乎指示了每个高亮区域内的比例或特定关注点。

**表面记录**

下部显示了一张未经修改的阿波罗12号表面照片,描绘了月球地形,具有典型的阴影、脚印以及着陆点附近被扰动的月壤。明亮的月球表面与完全黑暗的天空之间的强烈对比,为上方观察到的空中现象提供了背景。

**官方确认**

该文件明确指出,这些高亮标注识别出了在阿波罗12号原始照片中可见的"不明现象"。NASA的附带文字谨慎地注明,这些修改"仅用于背景说明目的",并不构成对所观察物体性质的分析性结论,在将其存在记录到历史档案的同时保持了官方的模糊态度。

events.title: Apollo 17 Triangular Formation Anomaly - NASA-UAP-VM6
events.record_description: As part of the review of historical UAP materials under PURSUE, DOW has opened a case to investigate the accompanying NASA photograph from the Apollo 17 mission, taken December 1972. The image contains three “dots” in a triangular formation in the lower right quadrant of the lunar sky that is clearly visible upon magnification of the image. While this photo has been previously released and discussed by keen observers, there is no consensus about the nature of the anomaly. New preliminary US government analysis suggests the image feature is potentially the result of a physical object in the scene. Additionally, as part of this investigation, the government has obtained the original film from the Apollo 17 mission and the results of the full NASA and DOW analysis will be released when completed.
events.report_summary:
**Mission Context**

This photograph was captured during the Apollo 17 mission in December 1972, the final crewed lunar landing mission of NASA's Apollo program. The image shows the lunar surface with rolling hills and mountains characteristic of the Taurus-Littrow valley landing site.

**Anomaly Description**

The photograph contains three distinct "dots" arranged in a triangular formation visible in the lunar sky (highlighted in the yellow outlined inset in the upper right of the document). These objects appear in the lower right quadrant of the original frame and become clearly visible upon magnification. The anomalous features appear against the black lunar sky where no stars would typically be visible in Apollo surface photography due to camera exposure settings.

**Historical Context**

While this photograph has been previously released to the public and discussed by observers over the decades, no definitive consensus has been reached regarding the nature of the anomaly. Various explanations have been proposed by independent researchers, but the objects have remained unexplained.

**Government Investigation**

As part of the PURSUE program's review of historical UAP materials, the Department of War (DOW) opened case NASA-UAP-VM6 to formally investigate this image. Preliminary U.S. government analysis suggests the feature may be the result of a physical object actually present in the scene rather than a photographic artifact, lens flare, or processing defect. The government has obtained the original Apollo 17 film for detailed examination, and full results from joint NASA and DOW analysis are pending release upon completion of the investigation.
events.report_summary_zh:
**任务背景**

这张照片拍摄于1972年12月的阿波罗17号任务期间，这是NASA阿波罗计划的最后一次载人登月任务。图像显示了月球表面，具有金牛座-利特罗山谷(Taurus-Littrow valley)着陆点特有的起伏丘陵和山脉。

**异常描述**

照片中包含三个明显的"光点"，在月球天空中呈三角形排列（在文件右上角黄色边框插图中突出显示）。这些物体出现在原始画面的右下象限，放大后清晰可见。这些异常特征出现在漆黑的月球天空背景上，而由于相机曝光设置，阿波罗月表摄影中通常不会显示恒星。

**历史背景**

虽然这张照片此前已向公众公布，并在过去几十年中被观察者讨论，但关于该异常现象的性质尚未达成明确共识。独立研究人员提出了各种解释，但这些物体仍未得到解释。

**政府调查**

作为PURSUE计划对历史UAP材料审查的一部分，战争部(DOW)启动了NASA-UAP-VM6案件，正式调查这张图像。美国政府的初步分析表明，该特征可能是场景中实际存在的物理物体的结果，而非摄影伪影、镜头光晕或处理缺陷。政府已获得阿波罗17号的原始胶片进行详细检查，NASA与DOW联合分析的完整结果将在调查完成后发布。

events.title: Airline crew & multiple witnesses: 5+ flying disks over Boise, ID (4 Jul 1947)
events.record_description: The FBI's 62-HQ-83894 case file includes investigative records, eyewitness testimonies, and public reports concerning Unidentified Flying Objects and flying discs documented between June 1947 and July 1968. The records include high-profile incident accounts, photographic evidence from sites like Oak Ridge, TN, and technical proposals regarding potential propulsion systems. Additional topics include convention programs, researcher accounts, and extensive media coverage from the period.  This file is partially posted on FBI vault with more redactions and some pages missing.  Included here is the complete case file with several newly declassified pages and only minor redactions.
events.report_summary:
**Source:** Oregon Journal, 5 July 1947, Portland, Oregon. Document marked CONFIDENTIAL.

**Primary Witness:** Crew of United Airlines plane over Boise, Idaho. The captain reported sighting five "saucer-like" objects which were "flat and smooth on the bottom and rough appearing on top." Objects appeared against the sunset shortly after the plane took off at 8:04 p.m.

**Sighting Details:** The crew saw the objects clearly and reported: "We followed them in a northwesterly direction for about 45 miles. Finally the objects disappeared. We were unable to tell whether they outpaced us or disintegrated." The captain emphasized: "Whatever they were, they were not another aircraft, nor were they smoke or clouds."

**Additional Witnesses:** Coast guardsman near Seattle also reported sighting. Portland police and citizens made multiple reports. In Seattle, Coast Guardsman Frank Ryman, 27, photographed an object from the front porch of his home which showed a "white saucer" flying over the north end of Lake Washington. A 7x5 inch print showed two tiny dots and a flaw in the print. Don Metcalfe, 19, Oaks Amusement park employee, reported seeing several objects "like spinning dinner plates" in the sky Friday, including picnickers and a woman who noticed them. In Vancouver, Washington, Sheriff's Deputies John Sullivan and Clarence McKay heard Portland police radio broadcast about the sighting and observed 20 to 30 objects "like a flight of geese" with a low humming sound over the sheriff's office, three to five miles away.

**Official Investigation:** Col. G. R. Dodson, commander of Oregon national guard, conducted aerial inspection after the reports and saw nothing "suspicious." Only known airplanes in the air at the time were 23 B-29 bombers near Astoria. Despite reports, at least two persons remained unconvinced, including Al J. Sanford (Col. retired) who believed the objects were cottonwood blossoms. Earl Hollison, 64, of 2604 N. Burrage avenue, telephoned saying he saw objects looking like "bits of aluminum foil, perhaps cigarette wrappers" about a minute after an airplane passed over his house.

events.report_summary_zh:
**来源:** 俄勒冈日报(Oregon Journal),1947年7月5日,俄勒冈州波特兰(Portland, Oregon)。文件标记为机密(CONFIDENTIAL)。

**主要目击者:** 联合航空公司(United Airlines)飞机机组人员,位于爱达荷州博伊西(Boise, Idaho)上空。机长报告看到五个"类似碟形"的物体,"底部平坦光滑,顶部外观粗糙"。这些物体在飞机于晚上8点04分起飞后不久以日落为背景出现。

**目击详情:** 机组人员清楚地看到这些物体并报告:"我们朝西北方向跟踪它们约45英里。最后这些物体消失了。我们无法判断是它们超过了我们的速度还是解体了。"机长强调:"无论它们是什么,它们既不是另一架飞机,也不是烟雾或云层。"

**其他目击者:** 西雅图(Seattle)附近的海岸警卫队员也报告了目击情况。波特兰警方和市民进行了多次报告。在西雅图,27岁的海岸警卫队员弗兰克·莱曼(Frank Ryman)在其住宅前廊拍摄到一个物体,照片显示一个"白色碟形物"飞越华盛顿湖(Lake Washington)北端。一张7x5英寸的照片显示两个小点和照片上的一个瑕疵。19岁的奥克斯游乐园(Oaks Amusement park)员工唐·梅特卡夫(Don Metcalfe)报告称周五在天空中看到几个"像旋转的餐盘"的物体,包括野餐者和一位注意到它们的女士。在华盛顿州温哥华(Vancouver, Washington),警长副手约翰·沙利文(John Sullivan)和克拉伦斯·麦凯(Clarence McKay)听到波特兰警方的无线电广播后,在距离警长办公室三到五英里处观察到20到30个"像雁群"的物体,伴有低沉的嗡嗡声。

**官方调查:** 俄勒冈州国民警卫队(Oregon national guard)指挥官G. R. 多德森上校(Col. G. R. Dodson)在接到报告后进行了空中检查,没有看到任何"可疑"情况。当时已知在空中的飞机只有阿斯托里亚(Astoria)附近的23架B-29轰炸机。尽管有报告,但至少有两人仍不相信,包括退休上校艾尔·J. 桑福德(Al J. Sanford),他认为这些物体是棉白杨花絮。64岁的厄尔·霍利森(Earl Hollison),住址为北伯里奇大道(N. Burrage avenue)2604号,他打电话说在一架飞机飞过他家上空约一分钟后,他看到的物体看起来像"铝箔碎片,也许是香烟包装纸"。

events.report_summary:
**Source:** The Oregon Journal, 5 July 1947, Portland, Oregon. FBI document stamped received 7 August 1947.

**Headline:** "PROWL CARS SPOT DISKS IN SKY HERE"

**Overview:** Multiple Portland-area law enforcement officers, private citizens, a United Air Lines crew over Boise, Idaho, and a coastguardsman near Seattle all reported disk-like objects on Friday, 5 July 1947. The Portland police alert was sounded over radio at 1:05 p.m. after East Side station received numerous calls that disks were overhead. Within seconds, two prowl cars reported spotting mysterious craft.

**Primary Witnesses - Patrolmen Lissy & Ellis:** Patrolmen Walter Lissy and Robert Ellis in Car No. 82 stopped near Oaks Park. Both WWII veterans and civilian pilots, they sighted three objects within 60 seconds traveling at great height and speed over the park. They heard no engine noise but saw flashes. The objects appeared erratic and changed direction in flight. The patrolmen stated that without knowledge of the objects' size, judging speed or altitude was impossible.

**Patrolman Earl Patterson:** Car No. 15 stopped at SE 82d Avenue and Foster Road to look eastward from where telephone calls located objects coming out of the sun. He saw nothing initially, but seconds later observed one craft coming from the west heading southwest. The object seemed to be aluminum or eggshell white and didn't flash or reflect light.

**Harbor Patrol Testimony:** Captain K. A. Prehn (Harbor Pilot), A. I. Austed, and Patrolman K. G. Hoff at the foot of NW Irving Street responded to an all-car alert. They saw objects heading south high over the Glebe hills at terrific speed. Captain Prehn reported the flashes prevented them from determining if there were three or six objects. "The disks would oscillate and sometimes we would see a full disk, then a half-moon shape, then nothing at all." The objects looked more like shiny chromium hub caps that "wobbled, disappeared and reappeared."

**Aircraft Veteran Assessment:** A former aircorps veteran stated the object was unlike any plane he'd seen, appearing radio-controlled because the disk could change direction at a 90-degree angle without difficulty.

**Conclusion:** There was a plane in the sky at the time, but all witnesses were emphatic that the disks were not planes. Planes seen, noise lacking.

**Source:** 俄勒冈日报(The Oregon Journal),1947年7月5日,俄勒冈州波特兰市(Portland, Oregon)。FBI文件盖章日期为1947年8月7日收到。

**Headline:** "巡逻车在此地上空发现飞碟"

**Overview:** 1947年7月5日星期五,波特兰地区多名执法人员、普通市民、一架飞越爱达荷州博伊西市(Boise, Idaho)上空的联合航空公司(United Air Lines)机组人员,以及西雅图附近的一名海岸警卫队员均报告发现碟状物体。下午1点05分,东区警察局接到大量电话报告称飞碟在头顶上方后,波特兰警方通过无线电发出警报。几秒钟内,两辆巡逻车报告发现神秘飞行器。

**Primary Witnesses - Patrolmen Lissy & Ellis:** 82号巡逻车的巡警沃尔特·利西(Walter Lissy)和罗伯特·埃利斯(Robert Ellis)在橡树公园(Oaks Park)附近停车。两人均为二战老兵和民用飞行员,他们在60秒内目击到三个物体在公园上方以极高的高度和速度飞行。他们没有听到引擎噪音,但看到了闪光。这些物体表现出不规则运动并在飞行中改变方向。两名巡警表示,在不了解物体尺寸的情况下,无法判断其速度或高度。

**Patrolman Earl Patterson:** 15号巡逻车在东南82街(SE 82d Avenue)和福斯特路(Foster Road)停车,向东张望电话来电所指示的物体从太阳方向飞来的位置。他最初什么也没看到,但几秒钟后观察到一个飞行器从西边过来向西南方向飞去。该物体似乎呈铝色或蛋壳白色,没有闪光或反射光线。

**Harbor Patrol Testimony:** 港口引航员K. A. 普雷恩船长(Captain K. A. Prehn)、A. I. 奥斯特德(A. I. Austed)和巡警K. G. 霍夫(K. G. Hoff)在西北欧文街(NW Irving Street)尽头响应全车警报。他们看到物体以惊人速度在格利布山(Glebe hills)高空向南飞行。普雷恩船长报告称,闪光使他们无法确定是三个还是六个物体。"这些飞碟会摆动,有时我们会看到一个完整的圆盘,然后是半月形,然后什么都看不到。"这些物体看起来更像闪亮的镀铬轮毂盖,"摇摆着,消失又重新出现。"

**Aircraft Veteran Assessment:** 一名前陆军航空队老兵表示,该物体与他见过的任何飞机都不同,似乎是无线电遥控的,因为飞碟可以轻松地以90度角改变方向。

**Conclusion:** 当时天空中确实有一架飞机,但所有目击者都强调飞碟不是飞机。看到了飞机,但缺少噪音。

**Cover letter** from HQ Fourth Air Force, Office of the Assistant Chief of Staff A-2 (Intelligence), Hamilton Field, California. File 4AFDA, dated **26 August 1947**. Signed Donald L. Springer, Lt. Colonel, GSC, AC of S, A-2.

**Subject:** Flying Disc.

**To:** Special Agent in Charge, FBI, U.S. Department of Justice, Federal Office Building, Room 422, San Francisco, Calif.

**Body:**
1. The attached true copy of a letter from **Mr. F. N. Johnson** was received by this officer 22 August 1947.
2. Your attention is invited to the similarity between **Arnold's early report** and this gentleman's report. A possibility exists that Mr. Johnson might have read some of this in the newspapers when Arnold was publicized re this matter.
3. This headquarters does not intend to investigate this incident. It is requested that a result of any interview you may make be furnished this headquarters.

**Inclosure:** (dup) — Letter from F. N. Johnson (true copy).

**FBI received stamp:** AUG 27 1947.

**Note:** Routing paper only; the F. N. Johnson letter is the substantive enclosure. Springer notes the suggestive similarity between Johnson's account and Kenneth Arnold's June 24 Mt. Rainier sighting, suspecting possible influence from press coverage.
